metadata.description: Create polished, scene-first infographic images from data, facts, or a topic — social graphics, stats posters, story/reel visuals, print one-pagers, link-preview banners — as a self-contained HTML/CSS+SVG page rendered to PNG. Ten fully-specified design languages, six canvas presets from square social to A4 print, computed-never-eyeballed chart geometry, colorblind-validated palettes, and a mandatory render–review–fix loop.
